caption:
You spent three days agonizing over something you'll forget by summer. Your brain treats every choice like it's permanent — but almost none of them are. The Reversal Test makes you check: can I undo this? Can I survive it? We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this.

#overthinking #decisionparalysis #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: you spent three days on a decision — you'll forget it in three months
